questions.topic: PrepLadder · 58.Instrumental delivery and induction of labor
questions.stem: A 29 year old primigravida at 39 weeks gestation has been in labour for the past 12 hours. She has reached full cervical dilation, but after 2 hours of pushing, she expresses significant fatigue and is unable to continue effectively. On examination, the fetal head is at 0 station, and the maternal and fetal vital signs are stable. All of the following are indications for trial of instrumental delivery except?

options.label: B
options.text: Fetal distress and fetal head at +2 station

options.label: C
options.text: Prolonged second stage of labour fetal head at +3 station
